name: State PSC / SSB (BPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC, RPSC, TNPSC…) — Apply
instructions: State commissions: one-time registration or OTR, then the advertisement-wise application. Domicile, category and sub-category are filled from your profile and asked once if missing. Fills from your profile first (no AI for known questions), asks you only for codes (OTP), passwords, captchas and anything new, pauses for your review, then submits. For Aadhaar/DigiLocker verification it asks you for the number, consent and OTP/PIN in chat and types them in (never saved). Payments are always done by you.

starterActionPlan.description: Register or sign in: fills your details, asks for OTP, password and captcha
Fill every page of the application (details, education, photo, signature, declaration)
